newsitem.title: USA: Genuine Parts sees record '97 sales, profit.
newsitem.headline: Genuine Parts sees record '97 sales, profit.

text.p: Genuine Parts Co on Tuesday said it expected sales and profits to climb to record highs this year.
Market conditions in the second half of 1997 should stay about the same as in the first half, the automotive parts supplier said.
Earlier, Genuine Parts said second-quarter sales increased to $1.5 billion from $1.4 billion in the same period the prior year. Net income rose to $0.47 a share from $0.44.
It said that its Industrial Parts Group showed sales improvement of 10 percent for the quarter. It said sales should remain strong for this group.
